newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bankruptcies down 4.5 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bankruptcies down 4.5 pct in May.

text.p: Company bankruptcies in Belgium fell by 4.5 percent to 617 in May compared with May 1996, Belgian trade and company data group Infotrade said in a statement on Monday.
In the first five months of 1997 a total of 3,445 companies went bankrupt, up 10.5 percent from 3,118 in the same 1996 period.
Infotrade said 2,400 jobs had been lost in May as a result of the bankruptcies.
